title: Selectable emulation pacing strategy
body: The pacing strategy (Semaphore vs VICE) is selectable in settings, applied live by swapping the gate on the worker thread, and persisted.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Strategy is selectable in the Settings UI (Semaphore or VICE)
Change applies live - the pump swaps the gate with no session restart
Selection round-trips through the settings DTO and persists
Unknown or null strategy defaults to Semaphore
